# App shell (T3a)

Project: `project.yml` -> `xcodegen generate` -> `OpenText.xcodeproj`. Targets `OpenText` (not sandboxed, hardened runtime, team QGPDXDQ9SW, automatic signing) and `OpenTextFinder` (sandboxed FinderSync, embedded in Contents/PlugIns). Swift language mode 5 in the app (Carbon/AppKit callbacks); the logic package is Swift 6.

## Layout
- `App/Logic/` local SwiftPM package `OpenTextAppLogic` (pure logic, shared with the Finder extension, `swift test` runs 12 tests): `HotkeyParser`, `URLRouter`/`AppRoute`, `FileRouting`/`FileKind`, `PasswordRules`.
- `App/Services/` `AppModel` (settings, hotkey, routing), `HotkeyManager` (KeyboardShortcuts), `SetupActions`, `BiometricKeychain`, `LockFlow`, `EngineAdapter` (stand-ins).
- `App/Views/Placeholders.swift` stand-in views. `App/OpenTextApp.swift`, `App/AppDelegate.swift`.
- `FinderExtension/FinderSync.swift`.
- `App/Info.plist` and `FinderExtension/Info.plist` are generated by xcodegen from project.yml.

## Decisions
- One window per file: `WindowGroup(for: URL.self)` (same URL re-focuses its window). NSDocumentController rejected: files are edited in place in many formats, no document model/autosave wanted.
- `.defaultLaunchBehavior(.suppressed)` on every window so launch shows nothing except the menu bar item and, on first run only, the setup window.
- Files and opentext:// URLs arrive via `application(_:open:)` and `.onOpenURL`; `AppModel.handle` de-dupes the same URL within 1 s.
- `RouterBridge` (on the always-present MenuBarExtra label and each window) gives AppModel SwiftUI's `openWindow`. Unverified at runtime (app was not launched): if the label view does not appear at launch, a file opened by cold double-click is queued until the first window/menu appears.
- Hotkey (rev 2): sindresorhus/KeyboardShortcuts >= 1.10.0 (MIT, the only package fetched), name `.quickCreate`, default ctrl+opt+N, `KeyboardShortcuts.Recorder` in the setup stand-in. settings.json `hotkey` is a readable mirror: written when the recorder changes; on launch and on app activation the file wins if it differs from the stored shortcut (parsed by `HotkeyParser`, formatted back by `HotkeyParser.format`). Press opens a small "Quick Create" window (MenuBarExtra .window panels can't be shown programmatically).
- URL routes: `opentext://new?format=<txt|md|csv|html>&dir=<abs path>`, `opentext://convert?to=<fmt>&file=<abs path>`, plus `opentext://lock?file=<abs path>` (Finder "Lock"). Only absolute or ~ paths, `..` resolved, formats whitelisted.
- Setup actions (default apps, open System Settings, `FIFinderSyncController.isExtensionEnabled`) only run from buttons. Setup window shows once (UserDefaults `setupShown`).
- Lock: password + confirm (min 8), Touch ID via Keychain item (service `com.walkertracy.opentext.lock`, account = lock id, `.biometryCurrentSet`, data-protection keychain), recovery key generated on first lock, shown once, only the public half saved to settings and only after the lock succeeded.

## Stand-ins to swap in T3b
1. `EngineAdapter.swift`: `StandInSettings` (-> `OpenTextSettings`), `newFile` (-> `NewFile.create`), `convertTargets`/`convert` (-> `ConversionEngine.targets/convert`; stand-in only copies txt<->md), `generateRecoveryKey` (-> `RecoveryKey.generate`), `lock`/`unlock` x2 (-> `Locker`; stand-ins throw `notWired` so no fake locked file is written), `lockID(for:)` (-> id read from the .otlock header; stand-in is SHA-256 of the path), `isLocked`.
2. `FileRouting.convertTargets` in `App/Logic` (-> engine targets; Finder menu filters to pdf/md/txt/png/jpg).
3. `Placeholders.swift`: `DocumentWindowView` (-> PDFReaderView / ImageEditorView / TextEditorView + format chip), `ConvertStandIn` (-> ConvertSheet), `LockSheetStandIn`, `LockedStandIn` (-> LockedFileView), `RecoveryKeyStandIn` (-> RecoveryKeySheet), `QuickCreateStandIn` (-> QuickCreateView), `SetupStandIn` (-> SetupView).
4. `project.yml`: uncomment the OpenTextKit / OpenTextDesign / OpenTextUI package entries and add them to the OpenText target dependencies.
5. Format-chip rename (`switchFormat`), `ConversionEngine.extractText`, combine/images-to-PDF drop handling are not started.

## Known limits
- Signing: `xcodebuild build` with automatic signing fails on this Mac ("No Mac Development signing certificate matching team QGPDXDQ9SW with a private key"), although `security find-identity` lists an Apple Development identity. Compile check done with `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`. Needs Walker (Xcode account / certificate) before running or enabling the extension.
- Keychain with `.biometryCurrentSet` may need a provisioning profile with an application identifier once signed; untested (no Keychain access in this task).
